text:
Priya: Quick proposal — trying to reduce modal friction for destructive actions.
Priya: Current pattern uses typed-confirm for most deletes. I think we should:
Priya: 1) Keep typed-confirm for irreversible org-level deletes (billing, data exports). 
Priya: 2) Switch project/resource deletes to a lighter banner + undo for 90% cases.
Priya: 3) Use inline contextual hints + aria alerts for form validation so modals stay simple.
Priya: Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/... (see 'Delete variations') :eyes:
Alyx: +1 on fewer modals. For the lighter flow can we do a secondary confirmation inline instead of a full typed box?
Alyx: Example: brief inline sentence "Please confirm you want to delete X" with a checkbox "I understand this cannot be undone" then Delete button disabled until checked.
Devon: For keyboard users we should move focus to the banner and announce it via aria-live="assertive". Also keep focusable Undo button in snackbar.
Ethan (a11y): Contrast nits: the yellow banner in the mock is 2.8:1 on text. Need >=4.5:1 for normal text. Also ensure the checkbox label is programmatically associated.
Sam: For high-risk operations (delete org, purge history) typed-confirm is still required. For everything else undo + shorter modal seems fine. Also watch for copy — 'permanently delete' vs 'remove access' ambiguity.
Priya: Copy suggestions: replace "This action cannot be undone" with "This will permanently delete {{name}} and cannot be recovered." More specific.
Devon: Inline validation for the delete reason field — use role="alert" on errors and set focus to first invalid element. Small log snippet for form validation API:
Devon: ```js
Dev.validate(form).then(err => { if (err) focus(err.first) })
Devon: ```
Alyx: Also propose using the required marker pattern we discussed: a subdued asterisk with accessible label "required". Avoid bold red asterisks that confuse scanning.
Ethan (a11y): Make sure we provide visible focus styles for the checkbox and primary button on high-contrast mode.
design-bot: Automated check: Missing alt text on mock image 'delete-flow-2.png' in Figma. Flagged.
Priya: Thanks — I'll update Figma with contrast tweaks and the checkbox mock. Plan: A/B test undo vs typed-confirm on project deletes next sprint. If we see more than 1.5x accidental deletes, revert to typed-confirm.
Sam: sounds good :+1:
Alyx: I'll update the component spec and add ARIA guidance.
Ethan (a11y): happy to review once updated.
Priya: cool — locking decisions for now. thx everyone! :tada:
